target_claim: Partner and celebrity characteristics have stable predictive associations with judge scores and estimated fan support after season/week adjustment.

leakage_risks: repeat contestants and partners require grouped validation
data_audit.missingness_notes: Missing home state is encoded explicitly; rare categories are pooled inside training folds.

baseline.name: season-week adjusted mean
baseline.validation: leave-seasons-out RMSE for judge mean and Q1 fan share

candidates.name: grouped cross-fitted ridge
candidates.formulation: One-hot encode categorical characteristics and standardize numeric features inside a pipeline; fit ridge models with entire seasons held out.
assumptions: reported associations are predictive, not causal
refutation_evidence: coefficient sign stable in fewer than 70% bootstraps
partner benefit vanishes on held-out seasons
candidates.decision_reason: Preprocessing stays inside grouped folds and regularization matches the sample size and interpretability requirement.

candidates.name: hierarchical shrinkage approximation
candidates.formulation: Estimate season/week fixed effects and partially pooled partner/industry deviations using ridge penalties.
assumptions: partial pooling approximates exchangeable group effects
candidates.decision_reason: Retains group shrinkage with a simpler deterministic implementation.

candidates.name: deep embedding network
candidates.formulation: Learn partner, industry, and contestant embeddings with a multilayer network.
assumptions: large labeled sample supports nonlinear embeddings
parameter_sources: 2,777 active rows but only 421 contestants and latent fan labels
rejection_evidence: 421 contestants and no observed fan-vote labels
interpretability is required by the question
candidates.decision_reason: Complexity is not justified by the grouped sample size or claim need.
